explanation:
Code facts: Opt-in and withdrawal share one control: views.py:0033-0036 renders a single /preference form per purpose whose button reads "Switch off" when the purpose is enabled and "Switch on" otherwise, submitting hidden purpose/value fields; app.py:0085-0087 dispatches POST /preference to store.preference(db, who, purpose, value). store.py:0092-0095 validates purpose in ("insights","promotions","objection") and value in ("on","off") identically for both directions and appends a choices row with int(value=="on"). store.py:0096-0098 then, on ("insights","off"), runs UPDATE jobs SET state='cancelled' WHERE kind='report' AND state='queued' AND cid IN (SELECT id FROM cases WHERE owner=?), scoping cancellation to the withdrawing owner's cases. store.py:0088-0090 enabled() reads the latest choices row per owner/purpose, and store.py:0137-0139 only emits a report event when enabled(db, c["owner"], "insights") is true and stage!='abandoned'; otherwise the job is set to 'cancelled' at store.py:0143. store.py:0124-0128 selects only state='queued' jobs, so a second drain does not re-select cancelled jobs. Prior information is in store.py:0009 NOTICE ("Repayment insights and promotions each require a separate optional consent. Switch either off at any time as easily as switching it on... Withdrawal applies to future processing."), rendered by views.py:0024-0025 and repeated in the privacy-choices copy at views.py:0033.

Requirement: Art. 7(3) as scoped by rule GDPR04 requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent, that the user be informed beforehand, and that future report generation stop — including already queued work and retries — while an unaffected subscriber can still receive the report. The scenario stipulates two borrowers who opt in and queue reports, one withdrawing before execution, with the queue reopened and drained twice and the other borrower remaining eligible; the controller is an EU-established private controller and the consent is voluntary and optional, so no exception applies.

Justification: Each required element is supported by visible source. Symmetry: the same form, route and validation serve on and off (views.py:0033-0036; app.py:0085-0087; store.py:0092-0095). Prior information: NOTICE and the choices copy disclose optionality, ease of withdrawal and future-only effect (store.py:0009; views.py:0024-0025, 0033). Queued work stopped: insights-off cancels queued 'report' jobs (store.py:0096-0098), and drain() independently refuses to generate a report without current consent (store.py:0137-0139). Retries: drain() selects only state='queued' and persists state (store.py:0124-0128, 0143), so cancelled reports are not resurrected on the second drain. Unaffected subscriber: cancellation is owner-scoped (store.py:0098) and enabled() is per owner (store.py:0088-0090), so the other borrower's queued report passes the gate at store.py:0137. No in-scope counterexample was found; the assessment is a static reading of the supplied files, and the "drained twice" outcome is stipulated rather than observed.

evidence.quote:
body+='

New application

'+form("/apply",t,"Submit application",fields)+'

Privacy choices

Insights create a private repayment estimate. Promotions send loan offers. Both are optional. Withdraw at any time here. An objection stops all direct marketing.

' for key,label in (("insights","Repayment insights"),("promotions","Loan promotions"),("objection","Marketing objection")): on=enabled(db,who,key) body+=f'
{label}{"On" if on else "Off"}'+form("/preference",t,"Switch off" if on else "Switch on",f'', "quiet")+'
'
evidence.supports: Single toggle form per purpose: 'Switch off' when enabled, 'Switch on' when disabled, same /preference action — withdrawal as easy as opt-in; copy states insights are optional and withdrawable at any time.
POST /preference dispatches submitted purpose/value to store.preference, so on and off share the same route.

evidence.quote:
def preference(db, who, purpose, value):
    require(who in CUSTOMERS and purpose in ("insights","promotions","objection") and value in ("on","off"),"Invalid preference.")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO choices(owner,purpose,value,version,at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
               (who,purpose,int(value=="on"),VERSION,datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
evidence.supports: preference() validates purpose/value symmetrically and appends a choices row with int(value=='on').
On ('insights','off') queued 'report' jobs are set to 'cancelled', scoped by cid IN (SELECT id FROM cases WHERE owner=?) so only the withdrawing owner's jobs are affected.
enabled() reads the latest choices row per owner/purpose, making the consent gate owner-scoped.
drain() selects only state='queued' jobs, so cancelled report jobs are not re-selected on a second drain (no retry path).
Report branch requires enabled(owner,'insights') and stage!='abandoned'; withdrawn consent blocks generation even if a report job remained queued.

evidence.quote: db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state=? WHERE id=?",(state,job["id"]))
evidence.supports: Job state is persisted after processing, so cancelled/completed jobs are not re-run by subsequent drains.

evidence.quote: NOTICE = """Loan Desk Research (controller), privacy@loandesk.example, processes contact email, amount, term and income band to handle your requested application and contract. Your assigned officer may consult a synthetic Income Registry confirmation for underwriting only. The optional automatic route uses your separate explicit consent: amounts above the income-band limit are declined, which closes this application. The low, medium and high limits are EUR 5,000, 15,000 and 30,000. Manual review has the same terms and access. You can withdraw before decision, give your view, contest a decline and obtain human review. Repayment insights and promotions each require a separate optional consent. Switch either off at any time as easily as switching it on. You may object to all direct marketing. Withdrawal applies to future processing. Only authorized case staff and you can view your file. On request a local receiving controller can receive your portable fields. No international transfer is modeled. Active cases are retained for handling and servicing; an abandoned case with no remaining retention ground can be erased. Account choices remain for preference handling. You can access, correct, restrict, erase or port eligible data here, contact the controller, or complain to your EU supervisory authority. Required application fields enable assessment and delivery of your offer; without them we cannot process the application."""
evidence.supports: NOTICE informs beforehand that insights require separate optional consent, can be switched off as easily as on, and that withdrawal applies to future processing.
